answer: Hidden canary tasks make each fake key do its own real work. The karst is a sealed pool of tasks with known answers, mixed into every key's queue at 1 in 20. Each correct canary earns one timber, the reputation unit that gates rewards, so a key with no timber is paid nothing. A ferrous tag, a per-key watermark in each canary's wording, shows when two keys share one solver, and both then lose all timber. So 1,000 fakes must each solve about 50 tasks per epoch at roughly $0.40 apiece, $20,000 per epoch, with no shared solver.
